verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity is an identity-verification API service, not an agent or AI client, so plugging MCP servers into it so it can use their tools is a category error for this product type. The evidence only shows Stripe publishing its own MCP server for agents to call (server role), which is a different story and does not show Identity consuming MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
